title: Recorded walkthrough manifest
description: walkthrough.json in WALKTHROUGH_DIR, next to walkthrough.mp4 and walkthrough.vtt. The gateway checks it at startup with the same rules in walkthrough.py and serves the three files under /app/walkthrough/.

build.description: The commit or version the footage was recorded from. The tab shows it next to the player.

recorded.description: The recording date. The tab shows it next to the player.

chapters.description: In order; each start is later than the one before.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the video.
